name: [UPD] Prospecting! 💎
desc:
Grab your pan and head to the river in Prospecting! — a relaxing gold-panning adventure! Search for gold, gems, and hidden treasures as you explore rivers, caves, and old mining sites. Upgrade your gear, discover secrets, and see if you can strike it rich!

⛏️ Pan for gold
💎 Discover rare gems
🤑 Use sluices to grind offline
🗺️ Explore new areas
🏆 Become the ultimate prospector!

Enjoy the game? Remember to like (👍) and favourite (🌟)!
